day: Day 1: Journey from Delhi to Mathura & Krishna Janmabhoomi
activities: Morning: Depart from Delhi to Mathura by car/train (approx. 3–4 hours).
Late Morning: Check into your hotel and rest briefly.
Afternoon: Visit Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple – the sacred birthplace of Lord Krishna.
Evening: Explore Dwarkadhish Temple, and enjoy the vibrant evening aarti at Vishram Ghat.

day: Day 2: Vrindavan – Spiritual Trails & Temple Hopping
activities: Morning: Travel to Vrindavan (20 mins from Mathura) and visit the iconic Banke Bihari Temple for morning darshan.
Late Morning: Explore ISKCON Temple (Krishna Balaram Mandir) and relax in its serene premises.
Afternoon: Visit Radha Raman Temple and enjoy a simple sattvic meal at Govinda’s restaurant.
Evening: Admire the beautifully lit Prem Mandir, known for its intricate marble work and light show.

day: Day 3: Govardhan Excursion & Return to Delhi
activities: Morning: Take a short drive to Govardhan Hill. Do a partial or full parikrama and visit Govardhan Temple.
Afternoon: Visit Radha Kund and Kusum Sarovar for a quiet spiritual experience.
Evening: Return to Mathura, have an early dinner, and begin your return journey to Delhi.
